artist: Cat Power Reflects On Bob Dylan’s Influence
title: Breaking And Entering: Cat Power Reflects On Bob Dylan’s Influence
summary: Ahead of her tour, Cat Power Sings Dylan, acclaimed American singer-songwriter Cat Power talks in retrospect about her lifelong admiration of Bob Dylan. She chats to Simon and Lauren about how growing up listening to Bob Dylan’s music fostered her songwriting style and how songs like ‘Mr Tambourine Man’ introduced to her a blend of punk's raw lyricism with softer melodies.
